name: GEM600
comments: 600mg gemfibrozil or 600mg placebo and 40mg of pravastatin were given to the subjects. Strenuous exercise, alcohol and grapejuice not allowed for 2 days and 2 weeks before study, respectively. multiple dose: placebo and gemfibrozil given twice a day. Pravastatin was only given on day 3.
